## Professional Profile
Antonio Jr. L. Piloton is a Software Developer, IT Consultant, and Academician with extensive production experience building enterprise-grade applications for local government units (LGUs), state colleges and universities (SUCs), retail businesses, and healthcare clinics. He holds a Master in Information Technology (MIT, Best Capstone Project Awardee 2023) and is a candidate for Doctor in Information Technology (CAR DIT).

## Core Capabilities & Engineering Stack
- **Backend & APIs**: PHP 8.x, Laravel MVC, RESTful APIs, Session & JWT Security, Python
- **Database & Architecture**: MySQL, Relational Database Modeling, Transactions, Query Optimization
- **Frontend & Mobile**: JavaScript (ES6+), React Native, Tailwind CSS, Responsive Web Design
- **Enterprise Solutions**: Barangay Information Management Systems (BIMS), POS & Inventory Systems, Payroll & HRIS, Student Information & Enrollment Systems, Multi-Tenant SaaS architectures
